skills.name: build-user-profile
skills.description:
Build or update the user profile memory by observing workspace context, git history,
and conversation patterns. Run on first interaction or when profile feels outdated.
Trigger words: "build profile", "update profile", "who am I", "user profile".
skills.description_zh: 根据工作区上下文、Git 历史和对话模式建立或更新用户画像记忆，适用于首次交互或画像信息过时的情况。

skills.name: skill-review
skills.description:
Review all skills for staleness, missing gotchas, and improvement opportunities.
Run periodically or after a series of tasks to keep procedural memory accurate.
Trigger words: "review skills", "skill audit", "check skills", "skill maintenance".
skills.description_zh: 审查所有 skill 是否过时、遗漏注意事项或存在改进空间，适合定期或一系列任务结束后维护流程记忆。
